name: WayriCAD Trace Refiner
description: Preview and validate small PCB trace jog cleanup by selection, net group or layer.
description_full: Refine short routing jogs and redundant straight segments using bounded displacement and shortening. Select tracks, selected nets, net filters, net classes or board layers. Supports up to 2,048 segments per eligible chain and review-table focus, metrics and proposal exclusions before revalidation. Preserves endpoints, widths, layers, locked and grouped routing. Differential-pair names and user-protected critical nets are excluded; custom length/skew/pair rules remain protected. Native connectivity and before/after KiCad DRC must pass before applying. Includes source/rule staleness protection and in-window Undo/Redo. Not a router, length tuner or signal-integrity qualification tool.
